status.$description: What colour a session's status dot takes. Each role names a theme colour; `statuses` lists the server's status strings (lib/ in nadinyamaui/briareus) that take it. A status in no list is `inactive`.

idle.$description: Done with its turn and ready for the next message.

attention.$description: Stopped short: waiting on you, interrupted or cancelled.

inactive.$description: Closed, or a status this version does not know.
